name: opulent
description: Deterministic model routing: Opus (or optionally Fable) leads as architect and orchestrator; implementation, tests, docs, UI checks, and exploration are delegated to pinned Opus/Sonnet/Haiku contexts. A hook guards the control plane and records what the main loop does — routing steered and auditable, not walled off. A Codex lane rides beside the Claude ones: OPULENT_CODEX closes the coder ladder and sends implementation to OpenAI Codex, and opulent-codex review puts it on a diff read-only as a second witness, with every cited file:line checked against the tree.
